description: Find by text/label/value/role/id and run action; the action defaults to click. The role locator matches snapshot kind vocabulary (button, text, text-field, switch, ...); pre-reconciliation leaf spellings (statictext, edittext, textview) stay accepted on the nodes that carried them during a deprecation window. The focus and type actions aim at a text field: the match or the field holding it, even beside other fields, or else the one enabled on-screen field inside the match. Several enabled on-screen fields inside the match refuse with AMBIGUOUS_MATCH and the field candidates, and a disabled target refuses with reason target_disabled. Web text boxes are not recognized as text fields. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

record.description: Force-record this out-of-band observation into a repair-armed heal (mutually exclusive with noRecord). Authored replay steps are recorded automatically and never need this. On find, valid only for a read-only action.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: find
